title: ChatSetHandler: step comments are misnumbered (3+5 label the lock block, but steps 3 and 5 are documented separately)
description: chat.rs ChatSetHandler has a comment block '// Step 3+5: Acquire the store lock once...' (line 205). Steps 3 and 5 were originally separate but were merged to fix a race condition. The comment explains the merge but the numbered steps in the comment still say 'Step 3+5' without renumbering the skipped steps. A reader counting the steps notices the jump from Step 2 to Step 3+5 to Step 6, missing Step 4. The intent was to remove the timestamp-outside-lock/create-in-loop structure. Rewrite as a flat unnumbered comment describing what the block does (acquire lock, capture old_state, create, capture new_state) rather than maintaining a broken step numbering.
